entities.name: Order of the Skyward Eye
entities.description: Knightly order of Bant embodying righteousness; crusades against groups that do not live correctly.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Alaran shard home to the order.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: Land that draws the order's ire for hedonistic pursuits.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who manipulated the order as unwitting pawns.

entities.name: Sword of Asha
entities.description: Artifact whose truth the order nearly covered up.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas manipulated the Order as unwitting pawns into spreading fear across Bant and preaching doom.
events.quote: The Planeswalker Nicol Bolas manipulated the Order of the Skyward Eye as unwitting pawns

events.summary: The Skyward Eye nearly covered up the truth behind the Sword of Asha.
events.quote: The Skyward Eye was also responsible for nearly covering up the truth behind the Sword of Asha .

relations.quote: Jhess in particular draws ire for it's denizens' embrace of what members of the order see as hedonistic pursuits.
